text:
[LADP.9.2] Three adapters in one rule — a weather-provider bridge (fixed:
`SunPhase`, `WeatherForecast`), a Home Assistant bridge
(discovery-driven: `Sensor` matched on `entity_id`), and a `light.turn_on`
call routed through the same HA bridge. The rule doesn't know
which adapter owns which pattern; each schema is owned by one adapter and
the compiler's service-dispatch table routes the call.
